artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan (5h): self-excluding build-waiter reaper pass in claude-refresh.sh (own pgid-bearing snapshot, two signature families, age-threshold-only gate), tests with mutation checks, both inventory tables + systemd ruling.

memory_candidates.content: In claude-refresh.sh, every non-Claude pass takes its OWN ps -eo snapshot with its own field list (LEAN_/ZOMBIE_/MCP_SNAPSHOT_PS_FIELDS). A new pass needing an extra column (e.g. pgid) should follow that precedent rather than widening SNAPSHOT_PS_FIELDS (which breaks fixed-position read sites and the fixture file); the reaper's own pgid/ancestors can be read from the 2070369 row of that same snapshot, keeping self-exclusion zero-query and race-free. Caveat: the test suite's fake ps binaries emit Claude-pass rows for any -eo spec, so new passes must validate numeric columns and the fakes need a branch for the new spec.
